evidence.name: Screen field: How visitors choose
evidence.userNeed: Know what "How visitors choose" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: How visitors choose
sections.description: Sets how people interact: browse only (no selection, like an intro list), pick one, or pick several. This also decides what's saved to the bound variable — pick-one stores a single value you can branch on, pick-several stores a set. Default to pick-one for most onboarding questions.
